title: Dario Amodei admits AI companies have not delivered on their promises
excerpt: Dario Amodei says the fairest criticism of AI companies, his own included, is that they have not delivered, weeks before Anthropic's expected listing.
content_html:
Dario Amodei wrote on X that the most accurate criticism of AI companies including Anthropic is that they have not yet delivered on their promises, and that only genuine breakthroughs will win public trust. It lands as Anthropic prepares a listing that backers expect to value it at $2trn.

Dario Amodei has conceded the case against his own industry. “The most accurate criticism of AI companies, including Anthropic, is that we haven’t yet delivered on our big promises to benefit the world,” Anthropic’s chief executive wrote on X on Saturday.

His prescription is blunter than the admission. “At this point, saying that AI will cure cancer is more a cliché than it is inspiring, and most people think it is deceptive,” he wrote. “The thing that will work is actually curing cancer.”

The timing gives it weight. Anthropic is weeks from a listing its backers expect to value the company at $2trn in October, a price that rests almost entirely on what the technology will do rather than what it has done.

The public evidence supports his premise. Pew found half of American adults more concerned than excited about AI in daily life, against 10% who were more excited, up from 37% concerned when the question was first asked in 2021.

He does not accept that his own warnings caused it. “I do not agree that my messaging has been disproportionately negative,” he wrote, pointing to Machines of Loving Grace, his 2024 essay arguing that AI could transform the world for the better.

His explanation is broader and harder to test. Public distrust of AI companies, he argued, reflects decades of scepticism towards corporations generally, and “AI is just the latest iteration of it.”

Others were unconvinced that breakthroughs are enough. An OpenAI employee replied that the pharmaceutical industry delivers advances constantly and remains among the least trusted sectors there is.

People will judge AI companies on more than results, she wrote, listing pricing, access, lobbying, opacity, how the gains are shared and who ends up holding the power.

Yann LeCun made the argument Anthropic is least comfortable with. The only way forward is AI that is “widely available, shared, and open,” the former Meta chief AI scientist wrote, a position Anthropic rejects for its frontier models while Meta presses Washington the other way.

Amodei ended with a schedule. Anthropic hopes for “incredible results in the coming years and some early glimmers in the coming months,” which puts the listing comfortably ahead of the glimmers.

content_html_zh:
Dario Amodei 在 X 上写道，对包括 Anthropic 在内的人工智能公司最准确的批评是他们尚未兑现承诺，只有真正的突破才能赢得公众的信任。 它落地之际，Anthropic 正在准备上市，支持者预计其估值为 2 万亿美元。

达里奥·阿莫代 (Dario Amodei) 承认了针对他自己行业的诉讼。 Anthropic 首席执行官周六在 X 上写道：“对包括 Anthropic 在内的人工智能公司最准确的批评是，我们尚未兑现造福世界的重大承诺。”

他的处方比承认的还要直白。 “在这一点上，说人工智能将治愈癌症更多的是陈词滥调，而不是鼓舞人心，大多数人认为这是欺骗性的，”他写道。 “有效的方法实际上是治愈癌症。”

时机赋予了它分量。 Anthropic 距离上市还有几周时间，其支持者预计 10 月份对该公司的估值为 2 万美元，这一价格几乎完全取决于该技术将做什么，而不是它已经做了什么。

公开证据支持他的前提。 皮尤研究中心发现，一半的美国成年人对日常生活中的人工智能更担心，而不是兴奋，而 10% 的人更兴奋，而 2021 年首次提出这个问题时，这一比例为 37%。

他不承认这是他自己的警告造成的。 “我不同意我所传达的信息过于负面，”他写道，并指着他 2024 年发表的文章《爱的机器》，该文章认为人工智能可以让世界变得更美好。

他的解释更广泛，也更难检验。 他认为，公众对人工智能公司的不信任反映了数十年来对企业普遍的怀疑态度，“人工智能只是它的最新版本。”

其他人则不相信突破就足够了。 一位 OpenAI 员工回答说，制药行业不断取得进步，并且仍然是最不值得信任的行业之一。

她写道，人们评判人工智能公司的不仅仅是结果，还包括定价、准入、游说、不透明度、收益如何分享以及最终谁掌握权力。

Yann LeCun 提出了 Anthropic 最不舒服的论点。 这位前 Meta 首席人工智能科学家写道，前进的唯一出路是“广泛可用、共享和开放”的人工智能，Anthropic 因其前沿模型而拒绝接受这一立场，而 Meta 则向华盛顿施压。

阿莫代以一个时间表作为结束。 Anthropic 希望“在未来几年取得令人难以置信的成果，并在未来几个月出现一些早期的曙光”，这使得上市轻松领先于曙光。
